LangGraph-compatible stream route source truth: `thread_runs.py::stream_run` creates a run through `services.start_run`, then returns `StreamingResponse(sse_consumer(...))` with `text/event-stream`, no buffering headers, and `Content-Location: /api/threads/{thread_id}/runs/{run_id}`.

RunManager source truth: `create_or_reject` supports `reject`, `interrupt`, and `rollback`; `enqueue` exists in request schema but is not supported and returns 501 through `UnsupportedStrategyError`.

StreamBridge source truth: the current implemented bridge is in-process `MemoryStreamBridge`; it retains a bounded per-run event log, supports `Last-Event-ID` replay within that buffer, heartbeats, `END_SENTINEL`, and cleanup after a delay.

Worker source truth: `run_agent` publishes `metadata`, injects runtime context including `thread_id`, `run_id`, `app_config`, and optional `__run_journal`, builds `Runtime`, attaches checkpointer/store, maps `messages-tuple` to LangGraph `messages`, skips unsupported `events`, streams `agent.astream`, updates status, flushes journal, syncs title/thread status, publishes end, and schedules bridge cleanup.
